title: Promotions
description: Automatic discounts and coupons with dates, minimums and usage limits

help.name: For the back office
help.label: What the customer sees in the cart (empty = the name)
help.code: Empty = applied automatically to whoever meets the conditions
help.combinable: If not, it applies alone or not at all (the biggest saving wins)
help.value: % or amount depending on the type
help.min_subtotal: Minimum product amount. With no minimum and no coupon, the reduced price is already shown in the catalogue

help.slug: Part of the URL. Empty = generated from the name

validation.code: Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only
validation.percent: The percentage must be between 0 and 100
validation.dates: The end date is before the start date
validation.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
